line: You are from Lilmoth. I do not trust you. The Hist's light is out. Its leaves are shut.
Our uxith is dark. That is where the eggs lie. Leeches crowd its roots. They closed the tree.
Pays-Late, our tree-minder, let them in. He goes down to the roots at night. The village sees him go.
I hold back my welcome. I will not open the tree to you yet.
Win me round with words, or bring me two piles of salt. We cannot make salt here. Our water is fresh.
You are from Lilmoth, friend. I am glad you came. We do not trust strangers now.

Two piles of salt. Give them here. Good. Salt is dear to us, because our water is fresh. Go to the tree.
The platform at the Hist's foot is mine. Walk softly there. Pays-Late goes down to the roots after dark, to wash the roots.
Two piles of salt, and you have brought them. Thank you, friend. Give them here.
